name: HUMPIRE RESPAWN
tagline: Algorithmic reverb with an 8-line FDN, pre-delay, damping, built-in EQ and ducking.
sub: Plate, hall, hammam and cathedral spaces
gumroad_title: HUMPIRE RESPAWN - Reverb VST3 + AU Plugin (12 Presets) | Plate, Hall, Hammam, Cathedral
summary: An algorithmic reverb plugin with an eight-line feedback delay network, pre-delay, damping, low-cut and high-cut filters and ducking.
about: HUMPIRE RESPAWN is an algorithmic reverb built on an eight-line feedback delay network with a Householder matrix, early reflections and a modulated tail. Decay runs from 0.2 to 20 seconds and Size from 0.5 to 2.

Pre-delay (0 to 200 ms), damping, early-reflection level, modulation, low cut (20 Hz to 1 kHz) and high cut (2 to 20 kHz) shape the space. Ducking lowers the reverb while the input is playing, so vocals stay clear.
The factory presets are grouped as Plate, Hall, Hammam and Cathedral spaces plus instrument-specific rooms.

features.d: Eight delay lines with a Householder feedback matrix.
With size, pre-delay and damping controls.
Low cut 20 Hz to 1 kHz and high cut 2 to 20 kHz on the reverb.
The reverb ducks while the input plays.
Slow modulation of the delay lines for a smoother tail.
Plate, Hall, Hammam and Cathedral categories.
Factory presets grouped by category, user presets saved by name, A/B compare, undo and redo.
Scales from 50% to 200% with the proportions locked. Simple and Clean display modes.

includes: HUMPIRE RESPAWN plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 effect on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I use it as a send effect?
faq.a: Yes. Set MIX to 100% when you use it on a send or return track.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The SAVE button stores the current settings under a name you choose, and they appear in the User category of the preset menu.
